subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should shared user-path resolution expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` placeholders for workspace and skill install paths, and how should unresolved or empty variables behave?
rationale: The code change is small, but AGENTS.md treats config/env surface changes as compatibility-sensitive, and the linked fix attempts differ on whether missing placeholders should be preserved or collapsed.

options.title: Approve cautious resolver expansion
options.body: Expand known placeholders in shared user-path helpers while preserving unresolved or empty placeholders and add focused resolver plus ClawHub install coverage.

options.title: Keep placeholders literal
options.body: Document `$VAR` and `${VAR}` in config-derived paths as literal strings and close the linked fix attempts as not planned.

options.title: Defer to broader dotenv policy
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38259 defines the global expansion and trust-boundary policy.

recommendation.title: Approve cautious resolver expansion
recommendation.body: Expand known placeholders in shared user-path helpers while preserving unresolved or empty placeholders and add focused resolver plus ClawHub install coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest history across the shared resolver and native ClawHub skill-install path.
